biotools.summary: Tools to analyze and visualize high-throughput metabolomics data aquired using chromatography-mass spectrometry. These tools preprocess data in a way that enables reliable and powerful differential analysis. At the core of these methods is a peak detection phase that pools information across all samples simultaneously. This is in contrast to other methods that detect peaks in a sample-by-sample basis.
